Anuradhapura Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi: to  receive,  accept,  implement,  perform,  and
administer  the  conditions  effective  to  any  real  or
private property which is held as belonging to or as
any  lawful  trust  with  any  Corporation,  charitable
society, board or any other trust ;
to appoint, dismiss or terminate the services of the
officers and employees of the Corporation, and to
pay their salaries allowances and gratuities as may
be determined by the Corporation ; and
to train employees for the benefit of the Corporation.
